name: velto
description: Local-first desktop text library and canned response app

scripts.dev: npm run build:preload && tsc --project tsconfig.json && concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1 --strictPort" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env VELTO_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron-forge start"
scripts.build: tsc --project tsconfig.json && npm run build:preload && vite build --config vite.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && node tests/e2e/smoke.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/transfer.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/shell.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/quick.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/organize.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/bulk-delete.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/capture.e2e.mjs && node tests/e2e/variables.e2e.mjs
